title: 🔥 "JUDGE NOT" – DOES THIS MEAN CHRISTIANS SHOULD NEVER CORRECT OTHERS? (MATTHEW 7:1) 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "JUDGE NOT" – DOES THIS MEAN CHRISTIANS SHOULD NEVER CORRECT OTHERS? (MATTHEW 7:1) 🚀🔥
📖 Matthew 7:1 – "Judge not, that you be not judged."
One of the most misused verses in the Bible is Matthew 7:1. Many people—especially non-believers and lukewarm Christians—use this verse to say:

❌ "You can’t judge me!"
❌ "Only God can judge!"
❌ "Jesus said not to judge, so don’t correct my lifestyle!"
🚨 But is that really what Jesus meant? Does this verse mean Christians should NEVER correct others? Let’s dive into Scripture and find out!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES "JUDGE NOT" MEAN IN THE ORIGINAL GREEK?
To understand what Jesus really meant, let’s look at the original Greek word for "judge."
📖 Greek: κρίνω (krinó) – "to judge, condemn, or pass final judgment."

👉 The word "krinó" has two meanings in Scripture:
✅ Righteous judgment – Discerning right from wrong and holding people accountable.
❌ Condemning judgment – Acting as if you are God, declaring someone beyond hope or salvation.
🚨 Jesus was warning against hypocritical, condemning judgment—not righteous correction!

🔥 2. JESUS COMMANDS US TO JUDGE RIGHTEOUSLY!
📖 John 7:24 – "Do not judge by appearances, but judge with righteous judgment."

✅ Jesus didn’t say ‘Do not judge at all’—He said to judge righteously!
✅ We must judge actions, teachings, and behavior according to God’s Word.

📖 1 Corinthians 2:15 – "The spiritual person judges all things, but is himself to be judged by no one."
✅ A true believer uses discernment to judge what is right and wrong.

📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather expose them."
✅ We are commanded to expose sin and false teachings.
🚨 If we never judge, we cannot warn people about sin, deception, or the need for repentance!

🔥 3. JESUS REBUKED HYPOCRISY, NOT RIGHHTEOUS CORRECTION!
📖 Matthew 7:3-5 – "Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye? … First take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother’s eye."

✅ Jesus is NOT saying "never judge." He is saying, "First fix your own sin before correcting others!"
✅ After we repent of our own sins, we CAN help others remove their "speck."
🚨 Jesus was rebuking hypocrisy, NOT righteous correction!

🔥 4. BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF JUDGING RIGHTEOUSLY
✅ Paul judged and corrected the church.
📖 1 Corinthians 5:12 – "For what have I to do with judging outsiders? Is it not those inside the church whom you are to judge?"
👉 Paul says believers MUST judge those inside the church who are living in sin.

✅ Jesus judged and rebuked false teachers.
📖 Matthew 23:27 – "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs."
👉 Jesus publicly exposed the hypocrisy of the religious leaders.

✅ The apostles judged false doctrine.
📖 Galatians 1:9 – "If anyone preaches a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed."
👉 Paul pronounced judgment on false teachers!
🚨 If we don’t judge false teachings, sin, or deception, we allow Satan to spread lies unchecked!

🔥 5. HOW SHOULD CHRISTIANS JUDGE? (BIBLICAL DISCERNMENT)
📖 Galatians 6:1 – "If anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of gentleness."

✅ We must judge with humility and love, not arrogance or pride.
✅ We must correct with the goal of restoring, not condemning.
✅ We must judge based on God’s Word, not personal opinions.
🚨 We should never judge hypocritically, but we MUST judge righteously!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: CHRISTIANS MUST JUDGE RIGHTEOUSLY!
✅ Jesus did NOT say "never judge"—He said "judge righteously" (John 7:24).
✅ We must correct sin and expose false teaching with truth and love.
✅ Hypocritical judgment is wrong, but biblical discernment is necessary.
✅ If we never judge, we allow sin and deception to spread freely!
🚨 STOP USING "JUDGE NOT" TO JUSTIFY SIN! JESUS COMMANDS RIGHTEOUS JUDGMENT!
